title: DataKitDeploymentLog - Data API
description: Represents the log details of a data kit component deployment. This object is available in API version 61.0 or later.

BundleName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
BundleName.description: Name of the data stream bundle if a data stream is deployed from a data kit.

ComponentName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ComponentName.description: Name of the component that’s deployed from a data kit.

ComponentTemplateId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ComponentTemplateId.description: ID of the data kit template from which the component is deployed. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

ComponentType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
ComponentType.description: The type of the component for which the deployment is tracked in the log details. Possible values are: MktCalculatedInsight MktDataLakeObject MktDataModelObject MktDataStream MktDataTransform Possible values available in API version 63.0 and later are: ActivationTarget DataAction DataActionTarget DataGraph DataSemanticSearch EngagementSignal ExtDataShare IdentityResolution MarketSegment MarketSegmentActivation MktDataConnection MktMLModel PersonalizationObjective PersonalizationRecommender Possible values available in API version 64.0 and later are: IrRelatedListEnrichment MktCalculatedInsight MktDataLakeObject MktDataStream MktDataTransform PersonalizationPoint PersonalizationSchema Possible values available in API version 66.0 and later are: CopyFieldEnrichment SemanticModel

DataKitName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
DataKitName.description: Name of the data kit being deployed.

DataPackageKitDefinition.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
DataPackageKitDefinition.description: ID of the data kit being deployed. Available in API version 63.0 and later. Possible values are: 1dk.Collections 1dk.SalesNextGenForecastingDatakit 1dk.Test_Fbdk 1dk.sf_mktg_ae__Marketing_Account_Engagement_CRM_Data

DataSpaceName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
DataSpaceName.description: Name of the data space the components are deployed to.

DeployJob.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

DeploymentAction.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
DeploymentAction.description: Deployment action of the data kit components. Possible values are: Deploy Undeploy

DeploymentError.description: Contains the error details if the data kit deployment fails.

DeploymentStatus.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
DeploymentStatus.description: Deployment status of the data kit components. Possible values are: Failed Started Successful

FileBasedComponentTemplate.description: ID of the file-based component template that corresponds to the deployment log entry. Available in API version 63.0 and later.

FlowInterviewIdentifier.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
FlowInterviewIdentifier.description: Identifier of the flow interview if the deployment was triggered using a flow.

JobIdentifier.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
JobIdentifier.description: Identifier of the data kit component deployment job. Available in API version 66.0 and later.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed the deployment log file.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this deployment log.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Nillable, Sort, Update
Name.description: The name of the deployment log.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The ID of the user that owns the deployment. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

PublisherOrgComponentId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
PublisherOrgComponentId.description: The ID of the component in the publisher org. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

SubscriberOrgComponentId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
SubscriberOrgComponentId.description: The ID of the component in the subscriber org in which the components of a data kit are deployed. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.
SubscriberOrgComponentId.refers_to: ActivationTarget, DataGraph, DataStream, ExtDataShare, IdentityResolution, MarketSegment, MarketSegmentActivation, MktCalculatedInsight, MktDataTransform

TemplateVersion.description: The version of the template from which the deployment was done.

special_access_rules: Users that have access to Data Cloud.
usage: Use the DataKitDeploymentLog object to track the deployment of a data kit component.
